item.title: G.O.P. Senator Weighs Forcing Congress to Vote to Authorize the Iran War
item.summary: Senator Lisa Murkowski of Alaska is drafting a formal authorization for the use of military force in Iran, seeking to put some parameters around the operation as the Trump administration has boxed out Congress.

item.title: Displaced by War, Many Seek Shelter in Beirut
item.summary: Over 100,000 people have fled to temporary shelters as Israel continues strikes on Lebanon.

item.title: Standoff With Iran Raises Fresh Doubts About Trump’s Freestyle Diplomacy
item.summary: A jumble of emissaries — a friend, a family member, a dove and a hawk — on the Iran crisis reflects President Trump’s improvisational approach.

item.title: Trump Extends Iran Deadline on Strait of Hormuz as Stocks Tumble
item.summary: President Trump pivoted after escalating threats. Israel also announced it had killed an Iranian commander leading efforts to block the Strait of Hormuz to almost all shipping traffic.

item.title: Mortgage Rates Jump Again as Iran War Effects Ripple Through Housing Market
item.summary: The average rate on a 30-year mortgage in the United States hit 6.38 percent, the fourth increase since the war began.

item.title: Australia Temporarily Blocks Iranians With Visitor Visas From Entry
item.summary: Iranian tourists with visas will be barred for six months in case they are ‘unable or unlikely’ to go back because of the war, Australian officials said.

item.title: Who Is Alireza Tangsiri, the Latest Iranian Commander Targeted by Israel?
item.summary: Israel said it killed the naval commander, Alireza Tangsiri, in an airstrike on Thursday morning. Iran has not commented.

item.title: Trump’s Threats to Europe Put Its Leaders in a Double Bind Over Iran
item.summary: European politicians risk angering their voters if they join America’s war. Yet they could also face domestic upheaval if they take no action to reopen shipping routes that Iran has blocked and ease an energy crisis.

item.title: Republicans in Congress Fret Over Trump Administration’s Handling of Iran War
item.summary: G.O.P. lawmakers who have given the Trump administration wide latitude to wage war with no congressional input are growing frustrated as officials offer little detail about ground troops, cost or timeline.

item.title: Trump Draws Bipartisan Backlash for Easing Oil Sanctions on Russia and Iran
item.summary: Republicans and Democrats alike have criticized the Trump administration’s moves, taken to stabilize oil markets rocked by the war with Iran, warning that it is benefiting two U.S. adversaries.
